label: ercot122 offerlevel (REJECTED probe)
definition: ERCOT-122 offer-LEVEL controlled refutation — REGISTERED PROBE, NOT A KEEPER CANDIDATE, run under owner overrule of DIAGNOSIS-ercot122 §5.1's recommend-and-STOP (ERCOT-118/119 precedent). The ercot129 keeper with ONE delta: the coal econ_low/peak bands moved onto the measured fleet-representative level from offer_curve_dam_hrmults_coal_yearly.json (§5.3's econ_low/peak_typical pair, the only two coal bands at 100 % capacity coverage and LOYO-stable) — resolved COAL_LIGNITE econ_low 1.216->1.3803 peak 1.550->1.4157, COAL_PRB econ_low 0.886->0.9777 peak 1.562->1.0027. econ_high and committed untouched (§5.2 forbids the pooled 2.856; §1 refutes measured econ_high as fleet-representative at 21-47 % coverage; committed destroyed by the 2026-07-22 slimming). VERDICT REJECTED on the pre-registered gate (PRECOMMIT-ercot132-legB, pushed before the solve): adoption required C1 coal mean|err| improve AND G1 not regress AND no new C-gate FAIL. G1 fleet-aggregate loading-vs-price REGRESSES 19/21 -> 18/21 — 2023 <$15 flips -0.046 -> -0.053, deepening the bottom-band miss ERCOT-127 §1 identified. Rubric profile IDENTICAL to the keeper (8 scored / 4 target-grade / 4 fails; C6 UNATTESTED). PREDICTION MISSES ON THE RECORD: the pre-commit predicted coal FALLS in every year and C1 would NOT improve. Coal fell only in 2023 (-0.184 TWh) and ROSE in 2024 (+0.034) and 2025 (+0.150), and C1 coal mean|err| IMPROVED 0.778 -> 0.679 TWh (2023 +0.371->+0.187, 2024 +0.797->+0.831, 2025 -1.167->-1.017). The level lever is near-inert on coal energy (<=0.19 TWh on a ~60 TWh class), independently corroborating ERCOT-122 §4: the coal defect is offer REACH, not offer LEVEL. Rule 1 — the C1 gain does not license the mechanism: the transplant is basis-mismatched (the artifact's pooled base-HR/flat-fuel divisor does not reproduce the model's per-plant HR x passthrough-sigmoid $/MWh, so measured $20.5 lignite econ_low lands at $23.38). Successor stays routed to the SCED TPO instrument (FINDING-ercot117 §E). Keeper UNCHANGED.
